visualization.title: What nivolumab is combined with in interventional trials

meta.interpretation: Interventional trials testing nivolumab with at least one other intervention, to profile which interventions are combined with it.
assumptions: A trial can have several values of intervention, so counts can sum to more than the trials.
warnings: Network shows the 40 most frequent of 1889 values.
